title: Refresh lifecycle receipts before rerunning an aggregate
failure_signature: A broad x1 rerun followed a targeted assertion correction before the new Method Flow pass witness and manifest refresh, so the aggregate reported expected ledger and blob-parity failures.
trigger_preconditions: A correction mutates tests or Method Flow after an earlier manifest was generated.
candidate_workaround: Withhold aggregate credit, complete the pending fail/pass Method Flow lifecycle, validate and summarize it, then regenerate the manifest before retry.
recurrence_guard: After any Method Flow or covered-file mutation, refresh lifecycle receipts and the exact manifest before a broad validation attempt.
rollback: Retain the premature aggregate as a failure and do not treat its passing subtests as an aggregate pass.
scope_boundary: Bounded validation sequencing recovery only; no scientific, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
